pre_execution_requirements: Implement/reuse the D1 authority, exclusive call reservation, native witness and output audit in a new D2 namespace; artificially test before scientific use.
Commit new production scientific SOURCE and seal exact used source, both saved bodies and joins, D1 baselines, wrapper, compiler and runtime; no unrelated worktree freeze.
Bind explicit execution approval and input/runtime seal to a newly issued single-use D2 grant. Neither old consumed D1 grant is usable.
Validate both body byte SHAs and saved token/phase/SOURCE-B correspondence before transformation. No generic rebuild or baseline recompile.
Accept only numeric, nonidentity, single-term PauliEvolution with original default LieTrotter settings and literal X/Y/Z primitives. Stop on anything else; do not repair labels, signs or angles.
Keep chronological instruction/wire mapping and exact source global_phase. Transfer aggregate phase once to ancilla P(phi); never re-add per-event phases.
New implementation QPY hash is recorded for integrity, not required to match generic-input hash. Preserve historical Pauli-PR mismatch and UNKNOWN cause.
Compile each target once using old profile; persist input/output QPY, fingerprints, histograms, counts RZ/CX, total/RZ/CX depth and compile receipts.
Only after both measured outputs and native exit/reap exist, compute signed central-minus-generic deltas and ratios with explicit denominator. No population extrapolation.
On any semantic/hash/input/runtime/native failure, stop and retain partial evidence, with no automatic retry or substitution. Do not use a new receipt to fill old native gaps.
